TestBddSchemas
 
TestCodec
Golden-vector codec tests (Fixtures generated by the metaprogram).
TestDeadline
Deadlines: grpc-timeout propagation + DEADLINE_EXCEEDED enforcement.
TestDynamic
Dynamic (descriptor-driven) runtime: schemas consumed as data at runtime, no generated stubs.
TestEcho
Loopback end-to-end: all four shapes, error status, metadata.
TestEventBus
 
TestHttp2Oracle
HTTP/2 oracle: the generated grpcdc.Http2Transport dials the official grpc-java OracleServer directly over TCP (no bridge) — the Java end of the generated HTTP/2 client support.
TestInterop
Interop: the Java runtime against the Go stdio harnesses (cross- language wire compatibility).
TestInteropOracle
Interop client grading: the generated Java TestService client runs the canonical grpc interop cases (generated table: InteropCases) against the official grpc-go TestServiceServer, through the bridge (dc-to-http2, stdio = DataChannel).
TestInteropServerOracle
Interop oracle, Direction B: the OFFICIAL interop clients (grpc-java TestServiceClient, grpc-go interop-client) run the canonical cases against the generated Java TestService server (examples/InteropServerStdio.java + examples/interop/InteropServiceImpl.java), reached over HTTP/2 through oracle/bridge.mjs http2-to-dc.
TestKafkaE2E
Kafka proxy end-to-end: generated Java client -> Rust kafka_proxy (--tcp) -> Apache Kafka / Redpanda.
TestKafkaNative
Kafka native end-to-end: generated Java messages -> libkafka_native in-process via the JNI shim (no proxy, no gRPC hop).
TestOracle
Oracle tests: the official grpc-java implementation, bridged over TCP<->DataChannel by ../..
TestPbMessages
Generated Java message types (one class per message) from the native protoc-gen-grpc-dc-java plugin: kitchen-sink round-trip plus a protoc oracle — protoc's own --encode bytes must decode to the same message and re-encode semantically identically.
TestSidecar
gRPC over WebRTC-Direct via the Rust sidecar, Java to Java: two direct_sidecar processes own the WebRTC stack; the Java server and client only speak length-prefixed TCP to their local sidecar (grpcdc.SidecarTransport).
TestTracing
Tracing: nested callee call joins the trace via the bound channel.
